selectedItems.observation: Current solution moves the circle center from (a,b) to (a−4,b−2), keeps radius a, excludes a≥4, obtains a=2, then uses b>0 to select b=4. Static SVG view shows the circle tangent to both coordinate axes, labels C(−2,2), T1 and T2, and a callout whose equations follow the same case split to a+b=6. ImageMagick static raster only; no browser render claim.

Current solution derives both tangents y=x±√10 from the distance condition and identifies their y-axis intersections A and B before evaluating AB=2√10. Static SVG view shows the circle centered at O, radius √5, both parallel tangent lines, A/B on the y-axis, and the marked segment length. The ImageMagick fallback substituted some title glyphs; source SVG text retains the intended labels. Static review only; no browser render claim.

Current solution converts the distance-to-line condition into |2a−3|/√2≤1/3 and derives the interval endpoints m and M. Static SVG view places C(m,m) and C(M,M) along y=x, shows equal radius 1/3 circles tangent to x+y=3 at T, and labels m≤a≤M. ImageMagick fallback substituted some math text glyphs; source SVG text retains the intended labels. Static review only; no browser render claim.
